title: My Profile
no_nfc_cards: You have no associated NFC cards

language.title: Preferred language
language.description: This is your preferred interface language. It is applied every time you log in.
language.saved: Language saved. It will be applied every time you log in.

help_what: It is your personal panel within the exchange network. Here you can see who you are within the system, what you can do and what security devices you have associated.
help_purpose: Shows your personal information, your member level, your security devices (Passkeys), your NFC cards and your recent transaction history.
help_usage: Read only. There are no forms here. To change the PIN of an NFC card, use the Change PIN button next to each card. To request that the assembly review your level upgrade, click Request Upgrade.
help_info_balance: how much you have available in your local currency.
help_level: It is the category that defines your credit/debit limits, your rights (voice, vote, quorum) and your permissions. The more you participate, the higher your level.
help_limits: The credit limit is the maximum you can owe (negative balance). The debit limit is the maximum you can have in your favor (positive balance). They are defined by your member level.
help_passkeys: These are devices that allow you to log in without a password: fingerprint, FaceID, phone PIN, USB security keys.
help_nfc: Physical cards associated with your account to pay at NFC terminals in stores. Each card has a unique UID.
help_pin: It is a 4-digit code that protects your NFC card. It is requested when making payments at terminals with a keyboard.
help_activity: Your last 10 transactions (income in green, expenses in red).
profile_over_limit_desc: Your balance is below your limit. You cannot make new purchases until you regularize.
profile_uuid_hint: Share this ID with anyone who wants to send you a manual payment. It is also included in your QR code.
profile_docs_desc: Add all your documents: ID card, passport, driver's license, etc. Comparison between federated nodes is done by type + number + country. There cannot be two identical documents from the same country.
profile_no_docs: You have not added any documents yet.
profile_country_hint: The country is required to avoid duplicates: two ID numbers from the same country cannot have the same number, but an ID from Venezuela and one from Colombia can have the same number without issue.
profile_no_level: No level assigned. Request an upgrade so the assembly can assign you a level.
profile_sponsor_hint: Your sponsor assigned part of their limit to you. When you level up, your sponsor's limit is automatically released.
profile_no_sponsor: You have no sponsor. Your limit comes from your member level.
profile_passkeys_desc: You can register multiple devices: fingerprint, FaceID, phone PIN, USB security key, etc. Each one will allow you to log in without a password.
profile_passkey_modal_desc: Give a name to this device to identify it (e.g.: "My phone", "Laptop fingerprint", "USB key"). Then your browser will ask you to confirm with fingerprint, PIN, FaceID or the security key.
profile_no_nfc_cards: You have no associated NFC cards.
profile_auth_hint: For security, confirm your password before continuing. This prevents someone else from changing your card if you left the session open.
profile_doc_for_card: Document to use on the card
profile_doc_for_card_hint: The POS will request this document when paying with this card.
profile_deactivate_desc: The card will be deactivated and cannot be used for payments until you reactivate it.
profile_activate_desc: The card will be activated and can be used for payments again.
